summary: Pitch Grand Designs and Home Town first as they have the strongest alignment with home focused viewers. Ads should target DIY genre across Channel 4, HGTV, and Netflix to reach ages under 25, 30 to 34, 35 to 44, leans female.

placements.why: A documentary about building dream homes that attracts viewers who care deeply about design and quality living spaces just like your customers
placements.send: Parachute bedding set, one queen size
placements.pitch:
Dear set decoration team,

Grand Designs showcases thoughtful home creation where Parachute bedding would fit naturally on a newly finished bedroom bed or draped over a sofa in a reveal scene. The product is free with no paid placement required and we can ship within a week. Your audience values quality design and intentional living spaces which aligns with our brand. We would be honored to support your storytelling with authentic home textiles that enhance the emotional impact of each build. Please let us know if this fits your upcoming episodes. Warmly, Parachute

Dear set decoration team,

I am writing from Parachute to offer our bedding for your upcoming home transformations. We know you create beautiful spaces for families, and we would love to help.

Our soft sheets and duvets could look wonderful on a primary bed during a big reveal or folded neatly in a guest room to add warmth to the space. The natural textures match the inviting homes you build each episode.

We are happy to send two queen bedding sets completely free with no paid placement required. If this sounds helpful, we can ship them within a week to your studio.

Thank you for your time and for the joy you bring to every home.

Warmly,
The Parachute Team

moves.summary: Grand Designs said no. Swapped in Dream Home Makeover, the next best set still filming, with a new letter.
No reply from Home Town. Wrote a short follow up.
Say I Do replied. Wrote the answer that confirms shipping and asks for their forms.
Shipped to Hollywood Houselift with Jeff Lewis. No air date listed yet, so the agent set a watch plan.
On screen in Dream Home Makeover. The TV campaign is the next move.

platforms.name: Universal Ads (Comcast)
platforms.how: Self serve from as little as $100, with no minimum commitment. Target viewers of content genres, plus age, gender and location. Reaches NBCUniversal, Fox, Paramount and others.

platforms.name: Amazon Sponsored TV
platforms.how: Self serve with no minimum spend, for brands that sell on Amazon in the US. Runs on Prime Video, Twitch and Fire TV apps. Target by genre and audience.

ads.note: Self serve platforms sell genres and audiences, not single shows. These shows are why these genres were chosen.
setup: Open Universal Ads and start a new campaign. It is self serve, from as little as $100.
Audience: people aged under 25, 30 to 34, 35 to 44, leaning female.
Networks to favor where offered: Channel 4, HGTV, Netflix.
Budget: start with $100 over one week, then keep what works.
